περαιόω: to carry to the opposite side, carry over

πλέκω: to plait, twine, twist, weave, braid

πονέω: to work hard, do work, suffer toil
πρεσβεύω: to be the elder; to be an ambassador
προγίγνομαι: to come forwards; to be born before, to happen before

προσορίζω: to include within the boundaries, add to a dominion
προσποιέω: to make over to; mid. procure, pretend

σπένδω: to pour a libation, (mid.) to make a treaty
στέλλω: to set in order, to arrange, array, equip, make ready
στρατεύω: to serve in war, serve as a soldier, do military service, take the field, march
στρατοπεδεύω: to encamp, bivouac, take up a position
συγκαταστρέφω: to bring to an end together

συμβάλλω: to throw together; come together; collect, contract, contribute

σφετερίζω: to make one’s own, appropriate, usurp

τεχνάομαι: to make by art, to execute skilfully
τρέφω: to nourish, rear, maintain; congeal, curdle
φθάνω: to come or do first, before others

ἀνέχω: to hold up; (mid.) endure, put up with
ἀναβάλλω: (to throw up;) strike up (a song); delay

ἀνακαλέω: call on, invoke; call back, recall
ἀναχάζω: to make to recoil, force back
ἀνταγωνίζομαι: to struggle against, prove a match for
ἀντιτάσσω: to set opposite to, range in battle against
ἀπογίγνομαι: to be away from, have no part in
ἀποδίδωμι: to give back, give what is due; (mid.) sell

ἀπονίναμαι: have the use or enjoyment of a thing
ἀρέσκω: (to make good, make up), to please
ἀφαιρέω: to take from, take away from
ἄγαμαι: to wonder, be astonished; be envious
ἄρνυμαι: to receive for oneself, reap, win, gain, earn

ἅπτω: to fasten, bind fast; set on fire; mid. touch

ἐκδέχομαι: to receive, to take over (succeed on the throne, an argument)
ἐκπαγλέομαι: to be struck with amazement, to wonder greatly
ἐλαύνω: to drive, drive on, set in motion
ἐντύνω: to equip, deck out, get ready
ἐπάρχω: rule over, rule besides; to be governor of; mid. pour first drops, serve
ἐπιγίγνομαι: to be born after, come into being after
ἐπιλέγω: say in connexion with; to choose; to think over
ἐπιλαμβάνω: to lay hold of, seize, attack
ἐπιμαίομαι: to strive after, seek to obtain, aim at; lay hold off, clutch

ἐπιστρατεύω: to march against, make war upon
ἐπιτέλλω: to lay upon, enjoin, prescribe, ordain, command
ἐπιτίθημι: to lay, put on; (mid.) to attack
ἐρύω: to drag along the ground, drag, draw

ἱδρύω: to make to sit down, to seat

ὀσφραίνομαι: to catch scent of, smell, scent, track

ὄλλυμι: to destroy, make an end of

ὑπαλείφω: to lay thinly on, to spread like salve
ὑπεκτίθεμαι: to bring one’s goods to a place of safety, carry safely away
ὑπεκτρέχω: to run out from under, escape from
ὑπερβάλλω: to throw over; outdo, surpass, postpone
ὑποδέω: to bind under: put shoes on
ὑφαιρέω: (lit. to seize underneath), take away, steal, take gradually, deduct
